div.div: مَا عَنْهُ مَفِيصٌ There is not any place to which to turn aside, or away, from it: or there is not any turning aside, or away, from it: syn. مَحِيدٌ [which may be meant either as a n. of place or as an inf. n.]: (As, S, O, K:) or مَعْدِلٌ. (IAar, M.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
